meta.title: 原相机直出显瘦技巧✨告别上镜胖一圈👋
meta.title_en: Look Slimmer in the Native Camera: 4 Poses

scenes.context: 人可以胖但上镜显瘦，不想拍得虎背熊腰，这四个姿势带这么拍。
sentences: Four poses to stop looking wide.
You can still look slim on camera.
paraphrase: Four poses to stop looking wide.
You can still look slim on camera.
scenes.speak: Four poses to stop looking wide. You can still look slim on camera.

scenes.context: 靠着拍照不要缩着靠，侧面把手伸出去，另一只手手肘内扣藏在身后就好。
scenes.speak: Lean, don't hunch. Extend one arm for length.

scenes.context: 回身却搭胳膊，前臂横在身前，轮廓立刻变厚，这是最典型的错误示范。
sentences: The forearm across the front thickens you.
Don't cross the arms when turning.
paraphrase: The forearm across the front thickens you.
用cross the arms换一种说法
Don't cross the arms when turning.
scenes.speak: The forearm across the front thickens you. Don't cross the arms when turning.

scenes.context: 回眸拍照不要打格格，向后打开成个三角形，再把尴尬的笑容挡一挡就好。
sentences: Cover the smile with your hand.
paraphrase: Cover the smile with your hand.
scenes.speak: Open back into a triangle. Cover the smile with your hand.

scenes.context: 剪刀手拍照不要贴着脸，把手往前伸，再往对角线里塞一塞就好。
sentences: Don't press the peace sign to your face.
paraphrase: Don't press the peace sign to your face.
scenes.speak: Don't press the peace sign to your face. Reach forward into the diagonal.

scenes.context: 修正的关键是手往镜头前伸，而不是贴在脸颊旁，这样会拉长比例、挡住脸侧。
sentences: Reach the hand toward the lens.
Don't press it against the cheek.
paraphrase: Reach the hand toward the lens.
Don't press it against the cheek.
scenes.speak: Reach the hand toward the lens. Don't press it against the cheek.

scenes.context: 撩头发拍照不要抱成团，胳膊打开撑在腰上，再挑补肩，另一只手抬起来些就好。
sentences: Open the arms and rest on the waist.
paraphrase: 用rest on the waist换一种说法
Open the arms and rest on the waist.
scenes.speak: Open the arms and rest on the waist. Lift the other hand slightly.

scenes.context: 听说你又踩坑了，下次可别踩了，记住这四招上镜显瘦。
sentences: Don't fall into the trap next time.
paraphrase: Don't fall into the trap next time.
scenes.speak: Remember these four tricks. Don't fall into the trap next time.

practice: Don't press the peace sign to your face.
